eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, Computing and Data Communication Systems (icABCD)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing
eventDetail.sponsors: Mauritius Section; Society of Information Technologists and Engineers Ltd
eventDetail.keywords: artificial intelligence,big data,Computing & IT,data communication systems,
eventDetail.scope: The conference aims at bringing together researchers and practitioners from all over the world working on soft computing, big data technologies, data communication systems and computer security on a common platform so that they can present and discuss emerging ideas and trends in these highly challenging research fields. ICABCD has the following thematic priorities: Artificial Intelligence, Communication Technologies, Information Security, Computer Vision, ICT in Society and Emerging Trends in Technology.
